integrity.claim_basis: Self-contained bijection to squared-cycle independent sets and cyclic gap enumeration; finite checks support but do not prove the infinite result.
integrity.literature_risk: Prior numerical extremal results identified, with unknown possibility of an equivalent full cardinality enumerator elsewhere.

scientific_limitations: Only finite simple prisms of cycles of length at least three are covered.
The numerical double total domination minimum was already treated in 2006 and is not claimed as an original standalone result.
The verification computation checks bounded inputs; the proof provides the infinite-family justification.
Equivalent unpublished, obscure, or unindexed enumerative formulas cannot be ruled out.
title: Complete double total domination polynomial and six-residue optimizer census of circular ladders
